question: Who won the Men’s Single title at Wimbledon 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Novak Djokovic.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Novak Djokovic won the **Men’s Single title at Wimbledon 2022.**
 
• He** defeated Nick Kyrgios** and earned his** seventh Wimbledon title.**
 
• He has won a total of **93 singles titles **in total till date.
 
• He is a **Serbian professional tennis player** and one of the most successful athletes in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nick Kyrgios**

 
 
• He is a professional tennis player from** Australia.**
 
• He has** won seven ATP** (Association of Tennis Professionals) **singles titles**, including the **2019 and 2022 Washington Open**.
 
• **In doubles,** he has won **four titles,** including a major doubles title at the **Australian Open in 2022.**
 
 
 
• **​Rafael Nadal**
 
 
• He is a professional tennis player from **Spain.**
 
• He has won a joint-record** 22 Grand Slam men’s singles titles**, including** a record 14 French Open titles**.
 
• He has also** won 92 ATP singles titles.**
 
• Rafael Nadal is** one of only two men to complete the Career Golden Slam in singles.**
 
 
 
• **​Daniil Medvedev**
 
 
• He is a professional tennis player from **Russia.**
 
• He has won **20 ATP Tour singles titles**, including the **2021 US Open and 2020 ATP Finals.**
 
• He has also won **six Masters titles**, and contested four major finals and nine Masters finals in all.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Women’s Single Title at Wimbledon 2022**

 
 
• **Elena Rybakina** won the **Women’s Single title at Wimbledon 2022.**
 
• She **defeated Ons Jabeur** in the final to win the Women’s’ singles tennis title at the 2022 Wimbledon Championships.
 
• This was her **first Grand Slam title** and the **first for Kazakhstan.**
 
• Rybakina was **born in Russia** but** switched nationalities in 2018.**
